Home » Exchange Opportunities

The International Programmes Office connects students with a wide range of global learning experiences, including exchange programmes, internships, summer schools, and short-term study abroad opportunities. These programmes are designed to enrich academic learning, build intercultural competence, and prepare students to thrive in a globalized world. Through partnerships with institutions across the globe, IPO supports students in exploring new cultures, expanding their perspectives, and gaining valuable international exposure.

P.S. Please start from the bottom—the most recently posted opportunities are listed there.

  • SCIENCES PO, FRANCE

    The International Programmes Office is pleased to announce that applications are now open for the PhD Student Exchange Programme at Sciences Po, Paris, for the upcoming academic year. This prestigious opportunity allows PhD students to spend a research period at one of Sciences Po’s renowned research centres. The programme offers access to campus facilities, libraries, workspaces, and participation in academic seminars and events.

    Eligibility

    PhD students (typically from the 2nd year onwards) with a strong academic background and a clear research proposal. Applicants must secure support from a faculty member at Sciences Po.

    Participating Research Centres Include

    • Political Science: CEVIPOF, CERI, CEE
    • Sociology: CRIS, CSO, Médialab
    • Law: Sciences Po Law School
    • History: Centre for History
    • Economics: Department of Economics
    •  

    Application Requirements (may vary by centre):

    • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
    • Motivation Letter
    • Research Proposal
    • Confirmation of support from a Sciences Po faculty member
    • Letter from thesis advisor (for PhD students)
    • Additional documents depending on the centre (e.g., photo, ID copy)
    •  

    How to Apply
    Nominations and applications must be submitted via the Sciences Po portal. For detailed information on each research centre and their specific application procedures, please refer to the attached PDF document.

    Application Deadline: December 3, 2025.

  • CAPES MOVE ÁFRICA PROGRAM, BRAZIL

    The Move África Program, an initiative by the Coordination for the Improvement of Higher Education Personnel (CAPES/MEC), provides scholarships to African students enrolled in master's or doctoral programs. The scholarships cover research stays of two to six months for master's students and four to ten months for doctoral students. Selected students will receive a monthly stipend, a travel allowance, a settling-in allowance, and health insurance as a lump-sum payment, in addition to a Researcher Support Grant (AUXPE) to cover consumable materials or third-party services related to the research project. Applications will be submitted through the CAPES platform, where the number of available spots will be available.

    To be eligible, applicants must meet the following requirements:

    • •     Be residing in an African country at the time of application;
      •     Have completed at least one semester of their master's or doctoral program at their home institution;
      •     Not be currently enrolled in a course in Brazil at the same academic level;
      •     Have no outstanding obligations with the Brazilian Federal Public Administration.
    •  

    Please find the CAPES Move África Program schedule below

    PHASE DATE
    Indication of available spots by Brazilian universities August 26, 2026
    Publication of the list of available spots From September 10, 2026
    Candidate applications From September 23 to October 30, 2026
    Selection of candidates by universities November 3–13, 2026

    Postgraduate Exchange Student Program (PEC-PG)

    The Postgraduate Exchange Student Program (PEC-PG) offers scholarships to foreign nationals for stricto sensu postgraduate studies (master's and doctoral degrees) at Brazilian higher education institutions recommended by CAPES. Over the past twenty years, the program has selected more than three thousand scholarship recipients, establishing itself as one of the Brazilian government's foremost international academic cooperation initiatives.

    Benefits include a tuition-free place at a Brazilian institution, a monthly stipend equivalent to that offered to Brazilian students, medical, dental, and pharmaceutical assistance through the Unified Health System (SUS), and a return allowance to the student's home country upon completion of the program. Applications are free of charge and submitted online, in accordance with the instructions set out in the current call for applications available on the CAPES website. For guidance on the application process, please refer to the PEC-PG application manual attached. I'm also sending the link to a website that contains important information about the program here

    Exchange studies courses – Uppsala University
     
    Eligibility:

    • •MPhil students;

     
    Under this agreement, the selected students will receive stipends for the semester to cover boarding/lodging and return flight tickets.  However, the students will be responsible for processing their visas and must also make provisions for out-of-pocket expenses for incidentals. The nominees are expected to pre-finance their flight tickets.
     
    Interested students should submit the following applications documents to the Study Abroad Coordinator at sacip@ug.edu.gh  and copy the Assistant Registrar at arip@ug.edu.gh:
     

    1. 1. A well-written cover letter. 
    2. 2. Biodata page of passport with an expiration date beyond 2028;
    3. 3. A letter of recommendation from the student’s Head of Department;
    4. 4. Original academic transcripts from the Academic Affairs Directorate;
    5. 5. Proof of proficiency in English letter (students must request this letter from the Language Centre, using their academic transcript as supporting document).
    6. 6. Current Curriculum Vitae;
    7. 7. One coloured passport-size photo.
    8.  

    Please submit the application documents on or before September 30, 2026.
     
    For further information, please call +233 (0) 593804305 or email: sacip@ug.edu.gh 
     
    Please note that only selected students will be contacted.

  • ALBERT LUDWIG UNIVERSITY OF FREIBURG

    The International Programmes Office invites applications from two (2) PhD students of the University of Ghana for participation in the Erasmus+ Student Exchange Programme at Albert Ludwig University of Freiburg during the Summer Term (February to July 2027) of the 2026/2027 Academic Year.
     
    Eligibility:

    • •PhD students (2nd and 3rd year in the Humanities).
    •  

    Albert-Ludwig University will provide the selected students with stipends of €900 per month to cover their stay and other allowable expenses. However, students will be responsible for processing their own visas and for any out-of-pocket incidental costs.
     
    Interested students should submit the following application documents (in PDF) to the Study Abroad Coordinator at sacip@ug.edu.gh and copy the Assistant Registrar at: arip@ug.edu.gh
     

    • •A letter of motivation for wanting to study at the Albert-Ludwig-University (ALU) of Freiburg, Germany (one page);
    • •Details page of passport with an expiration date beyond December 2029;
    • •A letter of recommendation from the student’s head of department; explaining the nature of the study or research to be undertaken in Germany and how the candidate and the home institution will benefit from this scholarship programme (maximum one page).  Please include email address(es);
    • •Original academic transcripts;
    • •Proof of proficiency in English letter (students must request this letter from the Language Centre, using their academic transcript as supporting document).
    • •Current Curriculum Vitae;
    • •One passport-size photograph (coloured);
    • •‘Letter of Acceptance’:  This letter must be on an official letterhead and issued by the respective professor who will supervise the PhD student studies at ALU.  The letter of acceptance must include the start and end dates of the programme as well as the working language and a handwritten signature of the supervisor in Freiburg.  
    •  

    Please submit the application documents on or before October 20, 2026   
     
    For further information, please call +233 (0) 593804305 or email: sacip@ug.edu.gh 
     
    Only shortlisted students will be contacted.
